name: semantic-java-completion
description: Intent-aware Java completion using JDT-backed type/member resolution, recursive scope-graph search, IntelliJ-style postfix/double-dot commands, and cursor-aware introduce refactoring.

semanticJavaCompletion.minimumPrefixLeng.description: Minimum typed identifier prefix before semantic suggestions are emitted.

semanticJavaCompletion.includeFields.description: Include class fields as semantic completion candidates.

semanticJavaCompletion.includeMethods.description: Include methods whose declared return type matches the expected type.

semanticJavaCompletion.maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of semantic suggestions injected for one completion request.

semanticJavaCompletion.receiverSearchDep.description: How many zero-argument member hops to explore from in-scope variables when looking for expressions that produce the expected type. Set to 0 to disable receiver-expression discovery.

semanticJavaCompletion.maxReceiverSeeds.description: Maximum number of method-scope variables/fields preindexed as roots for recursive semantic expression discovery.

semanticJavaCompletion.debug.description: Write semantic completion diagnostics to the Semantic Java Completion output channel.

semanticJavaCompletion.postfix.enabled.description: Enable IntelliJ-style Java postfix completion templates such as .new, .out, .var, .if, and .for.

semanticJavaCompletion.postfix.disabledT.description: Postfix template keys to disable (for example: ["fori", "optional"]).

semanticJavaCompletion.includeConstructi.description: Include new ExpectedType(...) as an intent-aware completion candidate when the expected type looks constructible.

semanticJavaCompletion.commandCompletion.description: Enable IntelliJ-style double-dot command completion such as expression.. for discoverable postfix and refactoring actions.

commands.title: Semantic Java Completion: Show Current Context
Semantic Java Completion: Diagnose Current Completion
Semantic Java Completion: Show Debug Output

scripts.test: node test/semantic.test.js && node test/postfix.test.js && node test/commandCompletion.test.js && node test/introduce.test.js && node test/scopeIndex.test.js && node test/memberResolver.test.js
